status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: This failed 41 times in the past 4 weeks on master branch, and is affecting patch testing.
This regression failure was introduced by https://review.whamcloud.com/63364 (LU-11509 ldlm: fix lfru priv_ratio_limit overflow issue).
Hi squalfof, as you authored patch https://review.whamcloud.com/63364 (LU-11509 ldlm: fix lfru priv_ratio_limit overflow issue), would you be able to look at this regression?

This looks like it may be similar to LU-19497, in that it mostly happens during rolling upgrade/downgrade testing, where the test scripts are running strangely. It may be that the new test scripts running on an old client version (e.g. client2?), so it may be necessary to add a CLIENT_VERSION check into the scripts, or otherwise determine what is going on.

The client1, MDS1, OSS1 versions are printed at the start of the sanity.sh output, so it may be possible to use that to help debugging. However, I don't think the client2 version is printed (though it appears in the test results summary).
This failed 8 times in the past week on master branch, and is affecting patch testing.
Sorry for the late response. I’ll work on resolving this by the weekend.
